_doc: What every film must have before it is rendered (film_check.py <work> <films...>) and what the out folder must hold after (film_check.py <work> --out <out>). Each item: id, fmt (long | short | out), metric (a function in film_check.py), op (>= | <= | == | true), value, level (optional "warn": a miss prints WARN and does not fail), why (Kamil's words or a measured reference). A plan may skip an item only with a reason: "skip": {"<id>": "why not in this film"}. Thresholds are data: change them here, not in code. Reference numbers: render/ref/research/teardowns.md (Jeff Su, Ali Abdaal, Kuba Klawiter, Fireship, 2026-11-04).

items.why: Producer role: story.json names the parts of the film and the word where each starts (Kamil 4.11: chapters entered where the part begins)
Kamil 4.11: 'nie podzieliłeś na chaptery treści z wejściem na ekranie', 'pomysł 3 ma wejście a reszta nie'; a chap card within 3 s of each part start
Kamil 4.11: 'najbardziej mi zależy na graficznym animowanym pokazywaniu moich pomysłów'; each part has a scene, float, slide or web card
One animated explanation every 2 minutes at least (AI LABS reference: a new picture every few seconds)
Film 1: 3.8/min, film 2: 1.5/min ('w ciul pominąłeś'); references 12-16/min
Seconds without a card, punch-in or b-roll; film 2 had 166 s

Kamil 4.11: 'na początku filmu jest zbyt mało bajerów'; references: about 14 cuts and many overlays in the first minute; Negacz 11-12 changes in the first 60 s in 8 of 8 films (style/REF-long-negacz.md L8): 8 -> 10
Kamil 5.11: the PiP window looked like the full screen pasted in; plan "head_track": true cuts it from the recording around the head
Skool CCC A19 (motion): a graphic enters ~0.12 s before its word so it is up when the word lands; plan "gfx_lead": -0.12
Kamil 4.11: 'pominąłeś np. zoomy'; references about 3 punch-ins a minute
Kamil 4.11: 'nie ma napisów za plecami' (behind.py, ADR-0005)
Kamil 5.11: 'WYZNANIE' behind the head could not be read; the speaker may hide at most 15 % of a card behind him
Kamil 5.11: 'zbyt często przenosimy się na osobny ekran i to rozprasza' (v2: 3.2 a minute); Negacz 1.32 a minute, IQR 1.25-1.44, 346 blocks in 8 films (style/REF-long-negacz.md L1)
A separate screen stays long enough to be worth the jump: Negacz block 16 s median (IQR 7-37, n 346, style/REF-long-negacz.md L1); merge neighbouring scenes into one block
Between two separate screens the speaker is back for 3 s at least (Negacz return 7 s median, 3 s p25, n 349); v2 had 0.1 s flashes of the face

Kamil 5.11: 'nie wszystko pokazywać na ekranie takim, że jestem w prawym dolnym rogu… zagospodarować przestrzeń dookoła mnie' (v2 68 %). Negacz has 65 %, Kamil's rule wins: the rest goes beside him (sticker, float, kw)

Share of the long with the bare face: no card, float, sticker, scene, lower third or b-roll from the EDL. Value from the course author study (Skool CCC, n=1: 18-26 % of a lesson); to be revised after the wider creator study (creator-study/PLAN.md 1.1, 0.4). Reconciles screen_share <= 0.5: the missing >= 15 pp goes into cards beside him (float, kw, sticker), not into full screens. Level warn: n=1, advice until the wider study confirms it (review 2026-11-07)

Kamil 5.11: 'czasami są one zbyt krótko i nie zdąży się przeczytać' (v2: 36 cards, the maps 1.4-3.2 s). Text: 1.2 s a word for the first 4 words, 0.35 s each after, 2.5 s min (Negacz 1.5 s a word, 3-word cards, n 92); a scene, web or slide 6 s min (Negacz drawn scenes 23 s median, n 101)

Top shorts bring the face back for 1.5 s [0.75; 3.5] between two full screens (style/REF-shorts-top.md T3, Kamil 2026-11-05: decide by the top retention creators); under 0.75 s it is a flicker, join the two cards
Top shorts end 0.23 s after the last word with no end board (style/REF-shorts-top.md T8, 30/30): the viewer swipes away on a board, a clean end loops
The long film in out/
Kamil 4.11: 'nie wiem czy nie jesteś leniwy z ilością shortów': every clip in clips.json with "make": true is rendered
Kamil 4.11: 'nie widzę plików z tytułami opisami per platforma': youtube/long.md with titles A/B/C, description, chapters from 0:00, tags; one file per short

Skool CCC So3/So4/C5/C10: each A/B/C title <= 60 characters, a word of ## Fraza kluczowa in its first 3 words, a filled zrodlo column (the niche title it started from), and its promise heard in the long's first 30 s (title_check.py)

Skool CCC B05/So2: every short that is made has >= 3 hook variants in clips.json "hooks", each clean of the 6 killers, "hook" one of them and "hook_from" a row of style/hook_bank.json (the proven hook it started from)
Kamil 4.11: 'miałeś mi zawsze robić a/b thumbnaile': at least 2 for the long, a cover per short

Skool CCC So5/So6/C4/Z6: at 320 px (a phone feed) OCR reads >= 80% of each big, one long variant without a face, a thumbnail shares < 50% of its words with every title (thumb_check.py); thumbs.mjs itself refuses letters under 12 px at 320, words in the timestamp corner and cover text outside y 220-1500

Kamil 4.11: posts ready to upload; 5.11: the graphic alone carries the message (post_check.py: OCR finds its words, WCAG contrast, 15-230 words) and the text completes it (60-130 words, <= 3 hashtags, last line a question for the comments: Kamil 2026-11-07)

Kamil 2026-11-07: from the film also a detailed blog article on kamiljan.com that links the YouTube film and adds what the film does not say (article_check.py: the site's post tests + >= 1200 Polish words, sources, numbers said or sourced)
